name: Legends Inscriptions
overview: Scripture reveals that inscriptions and engravings serve as tangible reminders of God's holiness and His covenant with His people. The phrase "HOLINESS TO THE LORD" is prominently engraved on the high priest's golden plate and even on the bells of horses, signifying consecration to God (Exodus 28:36; 39:30; Zechariah 14:20). Additionally, God's commands are to be internalized in the heart and visibly bound on the hand and forehead as frontlets, underscoring the importance of continual remembrance and obedience (Deuteronomy 6:6; 11:18). These inscriptions extend to household items and doorposts, marking both personal and communal dedication to the Lord (Isaiah 57:8).
